claim: The sample demo starts with a populated teacher review and saves no data to a real check-in.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /?demo=1; edit a sample review; assert no API requests and only demo: localStorage changes.

claim: Reset demo restores the shipped sample explanations.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; edit a sample note, reset, and assert the seed note returns.

claim: The sample review downloads a CSV with all three sample responses.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; download CSV; assert its header and three data rows.

claim: Teachers can use the sample review with a keyboard.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; use Tab and Enter through the skip link and main review action.

claim: The sample demo reloads offline after its first visit.
sandbox: Fresh browser context visits /demo online, waits for service-worker control, then reloads offline.

claim: Teachers can create a check-in and receive separate private links without an account.
sandbox: Fresh browser context starts at /demo, creates a check-in, and observes distinct student and review links without sign-in controls.

claim: A check-in stores its displayed form and response fields, private-link tokens, limits, timestamps, and optional voice metadata.
sandbox: Temporary SQLite database and upload directory; create a check-in and voice response, then inspect the stored fields, token shapes, limits, timestamps, and voice metadata.

claim: Recent teacher review links are saved only in the browser that created them.
sandbox: Fresh browser starts at /demo, creates a check-in, verifies the recent-checkins localStorage entry and same-origin requests, then verifies a second fresh browser has no recent list.

claim: Free teachers can choose one, three, or seven days before voice deletes.
where: Landing fact, creation page, privacy page
sandbox: Fresh browser context starts at /demo; inspect free schedule options, create a three-day check-in, and verify the student notice uses three days.

claim: Expired voice files are removed on the selected schedule while text remains.
where: Landing privacy limits, student form, privacy page
sandbox: Temporary SQLite database and upload directory; create a voice response, move its scheduled timestamp into the past, run production cleanup, and assert file and database voice fields are removed.

claim: Free check-ins accept exactly 35 responses.
where: Landing fact, creation page, plans page
sandbox: Fresh browser starts at /demo; create one free check-in, submit 40 responses concurrently, and assert exactly 35 succeed and five are limited.

claim: The product does not add a grade, AI-use result, proctor result, identity score, or misconduct score.
where: Landing limits, privacy page, terms page, footer
sandbox: Fresh browser starts at /demo; create and submit a response, then assert the teacher API returns only student input and teacher-authored review fields with no automated result fields.

claim: Students can submit every required form field using only a keyboard.
sandbox: Fresh browser starts at /demo; create a check-in and complete the student name, explanation, confidence, and send action using Tab, typing, Space, and Enter.

claim: Private links carry student explanation and confidence into review, save teacher tags and notes, and provide free receipt, CSV, and print controls.
where: Landing workflow, plans page, privacy page
sandbox: Fresh browser starts at /demo; use the separate links to complete the student-to-receipt-to-review flow, persist tags and notes across reload, invoke print, and inspect downloaded CSV content.

claim: The demo and classroom workflow send no requests to model, analytics, or advertising providers.
sandbox: Record every request from a fresh /demo visit through create, student submission, receipt, and review; assert every origin is the product origin and no tracking/model endpoints appear.

claim: A valid Classroom Plus license permits 500 responses and a voice schedule up to 365 days.
where: Creation page, plans page, privacy page, terms page
sandbox: Temporary SQLite database with a local recorded valid-license response; create a 365-day check-in and assert the API returns a 500-response limit.

claim: A revoked or invalid Classroom Plus verdict relocks paid controls while the free experience remains available.
sandbox: Fresh browser starts at /demo and uses recorded valid then revoked Sociobot verification fixtures; assert the visible license state changes.

claim: Sociobot/Dodo handles refund requests, and its recorded refunded-license verdict relocks paid controls while free check-ins remain available.
where: Plans page, privacy page, terms page
sandbox: Fresh browser starts at /demo and uses a recorded Sociobot refunded-license verdict; assert the merchant copy, inactive state, free retention options, and create action.

claim: Classroom Plus checkout is a $39 one-time purchase handled on the external Sociobot/Dodo site.
where: Plans page, privacy page, terms page
sandbox: Fresh browser starts at /demo; assert the $39 page copy and external-site label, verify the public catalog price, then make a no-payment live GET that must redirect to a Dodo checkout session before exercising the recorded page fixture.

claim: The production server is configured for port 8080 and a non-root checkin user, and can write its durable snapshot without root.
sandbox: Build the production frontend and release binary; inspect the final Docker user, run the release server under an unprivileged UID, create a record, and assert its snapshot is owned by that UID.

claim: The Container Apps deployment mounts its Azure File share at /app/data, pins SQLite to one replica, and checks private records across a new production revision.
test: npm run test:deployment-policy && npm run test:live-durability-checker
sandbox: Execute the deployment wrapper and live checker against mocked fleet, Azure, and HTTP controls; assert the exact share binding, ready revision transition, one active/running replica, 24 student, review, and receipt reads before and after replacement, submit/review persistence, and rejection of a reproduced private-link 404.
